_comment: Content for /upcoming/ (scripts/build_upcoming.py) AND for the machine-readable upcoming.json feed the Discord bot polls. Structure (id/status/target) is shared; prose is per language, keyed by the same ids -- the split data/changelog.json uses. The bot announces an entry ONCE, keyed by id, so changing an entry's prose does not re-announce it but adding a new id does.

ar.title: قريبًا
